listener_assessment: Groove, timbre and timing became unclear in the full-song output.

preset.caption: Isolated acoustic drum kit accompaniment. A restrained, natural groove with kick, snare and closed hi-hat, following the piano performance timing, phrasing and dynamics. Clear drum hits, tasteful fills and space between phrases. Drums only, no vocals or melodic instruments.

interpretation: Successful execution is not musical approval.
The recorded preset/source are consistent; long-context generation did not retain the preferred local result.
This result is not explained by song-chunk crossfades, because none were used.
The evidence does not isolate diffusion versus internal VAE processing or determine a unique cause.
Missing BPM/meter settings show audio-only conditioning, not proof that filling those fields would fix the model.
decision: Keep approved 30-second baseline. Treat full-song notebook as opt-in reproduction, not the next recommended quality path. No automatic new duration/seed sweep.
limits: Original full-song WAV and raw float waveform were not uploaded, so their hashes and pre-encoding clipping cannot be independently checked.
